newFindings.summary: The wrong tenant and all four binding negatives collapse into one OPERATOR_VISIBILITY_UNKNOWN code, because observe() wraps verify_reader in a broad except. The hosted proof shows that each negative is refused, but not which predicate refused it.
newFindings.failureScenario: A regression that drops, for example, the grant query's person_id predicate would still pass wrong-person if an earlier predicate also failed for that input. Today wrong-project is rejected only by the pure-Python binding/descriptor equality, before any database query.
newFindings.recommendation: Keep the external code. Add a test-only sub-reason, or unit-test each verify_reader predicate in isolation with every other field valid.

newFindings.summary: provisioned_reader(), the only binding source main() uses in production, has no test. Every test injects the binding directly, and nothing under tests/, tools/ or .github/ references recovery-reader.json.
newFindings.failureScenario: A defect in the root-owned /etc/saintvision/recovery-reader.json open chain (owner, mode, nlink, size, short read) would not appear until the live operator run. It would fail closed, so the effect is an unplanned HOLD, not an unsafe acceptance.
newFindings.recommendation: Before integration, add a Linux test that serves the descriptor from a fixture root (or injects the root fd), with positive and negative cases for owner, mode, symlink and hardlink.

newFindings.summary: The first-slot authority anchor proves only that the file is in the read-only container root image. The helper does not check the image ID against anything, and the proof does not carry authorityBindingSHA256, so the CP verifier cannot see which anchor was checked. The assurance is image custody plus the helper hash, as the source comment states.
The helper checks only that launch-signer.pub is 32 bytes. Unlike authorizer, operator and node keys, it is not required to differ from them. Separation is enforced only by the hosted fixture.

An expired PREPARED operation wedges the reference ledger until a forward-reconciliation procedure that the source does not define. cp.py always reports operationOutcome UNKNOWN, so join's PREPARED and expired branch is reachable only from injected test data. This is fail-closed, not unsafe.

The check of the /proc/<pid>/fd magic link and the linkat are two steps, not one atomic operation. The procfs magic check and the openat2 no-xdev open bound the risk to an operator who can mount a foreign procfs instance, which is trusted custody in this model.

The preflight hard-codes the 3-member rotation cohort (PC2/PC3/PC4). PC1's unique enrollment is NEW_ENROLLMENT and must not be appended to this cohort. That matches the separation in the FLEET5 authority replacement contract R1 (C2). The collectors hash CA and leaf DER only; they do not validate the issuer chain or the SPIFFE epoch.
